title: Failed to start recipe process
body: I used to love this app and use it all the time however he recently it doesn’t let me save anything no matter what I do whether it’s through browser paste the link or anything it just says I failed to start the recipe processors every single time. And yes, the app is up-to-date.

title: Broken
body: It worked flawlessly two weeks ago now it’s broken. Just canceled my subscription.

title: App not working
body: I actually have liked using this app, it within the last week I have been unable to open the app. It just keeps spinning…

title: Stashcook?
body: After filling out the survey it wants me to subscribe to “stashcook” for $30 a month. Not sure what this has to do with saving recipes from social media.

title: Bs
body: You have to pay to have the app

title: Really?? My entire life??
body: I don’t need a cookbook that once my entire life on file this is ridiculous. The old cookbook, before it was called stashcook was much better. My age group shouldn’t be required to use it. That’s nonsense. And now you charge for it? I’m deleting the app. This is ridiculous. Why couldn’t you have just left the old app the way it was? I’ve been using this app for years and now I can’t thanks.

title: Not actual recipe
body: The recipe that is saved does not match the recipe that you’re trying to save. It says that it’s AI enhanced. Therefore it is often a completely different recipe. Came back again continue to try to save recipes. Not a single recipe was the actual recipe that I viewed on the YouTube video. But whatever AI searched out using that name for the recipe so they are completely different than the one that you’re seeing.

title: Refund
body: I canceled my trial and was still charged for the year. I contacted Apple to request a refund and it got denied twice with no explanation. I just want my money back for an app I don’t use!

title: Free
body: Not sure about the free trail. Nothing shows the price or how long the trail lasts.

title: I want a refund.
body: I canceled my subscription December 1st. Tell me why it still charged me $30 December 8th for the yearly plan I wasn’t even subscribed to.

title: Absolute garbage of an app
body: This app hasn’t worked since I began paying - the only way I can get it to work is to delete it, reinstall it, then it works for a day. Save your money and look elsewhere.

title: False advertising
body: This description of “no charges and no membership” is a total lie. This actually costs money after a 7 day trial. Not sure why the developers couldn’t just be upfront about that from the get-go…

title: It isn’t free
body: I just downloaded this app, hopeful for an organized way to house all of my online recipes. Well, it’s only a free trial. They lure you in with th download being free then try to charge. Forget it, why would anyone pay for this?!? Print the recipe or write it down and put it in a recipe book.

title: Does not sync
body: Got this for my husband and I to use but we can’t get it to sync and I tried to log out and back in but now all my recipes are gone

title: Good idea but the app needs fixing
body: I was using the app for a bit and it was working fine but for the past 2 weeks anytime I try opening the app it doesn’t even load in and I paid for the yearly subscription so now I’m paying for nothing

title: Needed somewhere for recipes
body: I don’t wanna come off as stingy or whatever anyone will think I am for this, but I save recipes on TikTok and Instagram all the time so when I saw an ad on Instagram I thought why not it’ll help out. Yet they fail to tell you in the ad’s that you have to pay in order to use this app. You can download it for free then you get a free trial but once that trial is over you have to pay to continue to use the app. I wouldn’t he do made if I was TOLD in the AD beforehand that I had to pay. I just think it’s ridiculous that I had to fully download the app and see that I’m getting a free trial and having to pay for the app afterwards. Not the bet marketing skills for an app.

title: AI
body: Main feature I got it for does not work well. Scan instagram video and tons of wording is off and ingredient measurements (even tho all ingredients are in the video description.) currently do not recommend buying premium for this.

title: Sick of subscriptions
body: I’m really tired of every mildly useful app requiring a subscription. It makes you go through this whole quiz and nonsense before saying “we’ll let you try it for free” without even SAYING what the price is until after you’ve pressed the free trial button? Seemed like a useful app but I probably won’t be using it due to my distaste for subscriptions and sneaky ways to get you to pay for them.

title: Can’t stash on iOS
body: I loved this app on my Android phone but stashing recipes doesn’t work from Chrome on iOS. And when I went into the App to send feedback, the feedback form wouldn’t work either. I know iOS makes things harder on devs but please go the extra mile to prevent these usability issues.

title: Issues
body: The app keeps crashing. It’s not easy to find someone to communicate with in order to fix it. Pretty disappointing so far. I would give it another review if someone would contact me to figure this out.

title: Needs a little fixing
body: The app works well, I’m impressed. One thing needs fixing is the option dots on the upper right, when touched, it does not stay open and have to touch it several times. And selecting ‘send’, nothing happens so I cannot share.

title: Misleading prices
body: The in app purchases section of the App Store gives you 10 different payment options including a lifetime option. The actual app pigeon holes you into 4 payment options and removes the lifetime option.

title: Great but missing recipes
body: Had about 100-150 recipes stashed in this room a break from cooking for health reasons, came back to only 37 out of about 125 recipes, angry and can’t find the original recipe cause I got them all from instagram, some of them that aren’t there I found again, videos weren’t deleted somehow the recipe disappeared, was going to surprised my many upcoming birthday parts with tons of food most of the stuff that left are snacks and barbecue stuff which my grill is broken, unrelated. Very Sad. Edit, I luckily had most of the recipes saved to a folder within Instagram, but most of them don’t have listed ingredients or methods. My original rating was a 2 but honestly for how well the app scans and picks up on the actual words that are being said is amazing so I’m giving it a 3 as most of the good reviews are 4

title: Needs iPad Version
body: I like the app a lot, but it badly needs an iPad-optimized version. Having to use your phone in the kitchen with messy hands is far from ideal. Would be 5 stars otherwise.

title: Great- Until Bug Issues
body: I absolutely loved this app at first! I was able to send all of my saved recipes from Facebook and TikTok. I could even put them in separate categories and keep them organized. I didn’t have to purchase a subscription to be able to use it. Everything was fine until a couple weeks ago. My app stopped loading up any of my recipes, so I would have to log out and log back in. Now, a lot of my recipes have simply disappeared. I hope they’re not deleted forever and it’s just a bug that will fix itself as I spent hours uploading all of them. To the creators of this app, please fix these bug issues. I love this app so much, I don’t want to have to find another one!

title: Awesome but not great!
body: First of all, I love the app, it is amazing and works for the most part like it should. However, when dashing an app from social medias, it may or may not put the correct cooking order in the order of the way it should be. So in doing that, you have to go back and check every recipe you store if it’s pulling it from social media. The copy and paste text method works wonderful that I’ve found. I use it almost on a daily basis pulling recipes that I’ve found from social media into one place where I can review them save them and use them without having to print out every recipe I find.

title: Share the App?
body: I love the app. I’m very stingy about paying app subscriptions but this is worth it to me. The only thing that bums me out is that I can’t family-share the app with my husband without him also having to buy a subscription, so the meal planning is still on me.

title: Wonderful for keeping recipes
body: The best app I’ve found for being able to accurately pull recipes from a variety of sources. Only two things I would like to see is a label for multiple meals a day (what’s lunch versus dinner sides for example) and a way to keep a freezer meal inventory. That would make this a perfect app.

title: Like it a lot, but missing one thing
body: I like this app a lot. I use the recipe storage and shopping list the most. There is really only one thing I don’t like (or I can’t get information on how to do). When I add my own recipe, I cannot figure out how to add a negative amount of an ingredient. For example, I have an InstaPot Greek Yogurt recipe that I use with FairLife Whole Milk. After the yogurt is made, I drain out about 2 cups of liquid acid Whey. I can’t figure out how to adjust the recipe so the nutrition information is correct. Other than that, I LOVE it.

title: Love Stashcook but..
body: I have paid extra for premium and I am inundated with ads still, it’s frustrating! I can’t add new recipes without being attacked by ads. I would be devastated to have to abandon for a different solution. Is there some way to reduce the interruption or a necessary evil?

title: Best recipe collection app I’ve found
body: I enjoy collecting recipes and appreciate having my wide variety of recipes available without printing them out. The app occasionally crashes or stalls when adding a recipe.

title: Best meal planning app!!
body: I love this app!! Makes meal planning and grocery shopping super easy! Don’t love that it advertises premium every time I open the app though. Super convenient in every other way though!

title: Awesome digital recipe storage
body: Only thing I don’t like is the limit of how many new recipes you can search for per day without paying.

title: Sounds like an interesting concept
body: So good so far

title: Organization is the key ingredient!
body: I’ve been using this app for a few weeks now. I’m extremely pleased with the interface and the ability to easily add, edit and organize my recipes and collections. My absolute favorite feature is the ability to update a recipe based on number of servings. It has totally changed the way I cook. Not only can I plan for meals, but if I’m in a rush, I can pick a recipe (sorted by cook time!) and have a meal ready in 30 minutes or less - and no more wasted leftovers that absolutely no-one eats! Two things I’d like to see updated. 1) add the ability to sort by favorites (I want to pull up my 5-star recipes first!) and 2) add the ability to transfer my shopping list items to other apps. I will give this app 6 stars if you can make it happen. Truly no complaints. This app is a serious upgrade to how I used to manage my recipes. Highlighting, copying and pasting from websites or digging through cookbooks is an in-sane process to me now. Now I just have one place I go to quickly add or find a recipe, check my ingredients and I’m cooking, literally. I also love that the app overrides my phone auto-sleep feature to stay open while I cook. Yet another reason for the five-star rating. Great job, StashCook!

title: Thanks
body: This is an awesome app

title: Great
body: This is amazing

title: LOVE this app!!!!!!
body: This is, by far, my most favorite app!!! I am able to save AND organize recipes! I’ve cooked more since finding this amazing app. Great job!!!! Please keep this around … it’s a phenomenal app indeed!

title: Cautiously Optimistic!
body: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️So far, I love this app. Normally, I don’t review this early in my use. I love that you can transfer recipes from notecards, cookbooks, online…that is an amazing feature. My brother showed me a free one that also had those three features—however, it did NOT give users the option to edit recipes within the app. The only feature I haven’t tried yet or seen how it comes across is sharing recipes and my recipe stack with my family. I haven’t been disappointed yet, so I am optimistic the five-star review will stand when I do.

title: So glad I use this
body: I downloaded this app after too much frustration downloading online recipes with an app I had used for many years that recently claimed it could download from FB, etc. This app makes download recipes from social media a breeze and the meal planner is great. The only thing I’d like to see added is a “tools“ description where possible, e.g. springform pan, piping bag, etc. to help with the mise en place. This is a great app and wonderful organizer and time saver!

title: The best
body: This is the best recipe app out there. I’ve tried them all. I NEVER use apps that have a fee. Until now. Worth every penny. Easy to use. Great organization. And you can watch the video inside the app! Well done

title: Great app
body: Once I got it working I was amazed! Better instructions on making an account, but great app

title: AMAZING APP
body: I absolutely love this app. I installed a couple other apps recently for the first time but none of them compare to Stashcook! I am deleting the others today. There was an awesome video where a guy made some potato balls that looked so good. Unfortunately there was no actual recipe and when I saved it to another app it just showed a picture but no ingredients and no directions. I saved it to Stashcook and now I have a complete recipe with ingredients and instructions and all!! It’s truly amazing!

title: My sister & I love this app!
body: I’ve been using Stashcook for a few years now and commonly recommend it as a registered dietitian. It’s so helpful to plan your meals and create a grocery list. I just recently upgraded to the premium. version and love being able to take pictures of my cookbook recipes now too.

title: So incredible
body: I honestly had my doubts about this app when I first got it. And I personally don’t really write reviews so I think it’s safe to say this app blew my mind. I get all my meal prep recipes off Instagram, I used to save them right on instagram along with everything else I found interesting, so needless to say all my recipes got lost immediately. With this app, all my stuff is in one spot, and the fact that there are step by step instructions? AMAZING. I’m so thankful that feature is included in the free version, I don’t have the money for premium personally but if you’re able to shell out the money I would recommend it. You can track your macros which will only help you with your weight goals. Overall 10/10 app, I’m so thankful, I’m actually making the viral meals I see online and developing a more diverse personal menu. Thank you!!

title: Game changer!
body: We have been using this app for our family, and it has made dinner time more organized. If I can’t make it one night my husband can just look at the calendar to cook. The only hiccup is I keep getting ads after paying for premium. One thing that would be amazing is if it integrated with Kroger to add items to a shopping list for order.

title: Best meal planning app
body: It stores personal recipes and also downloads recipes from websites. The recipes are scalable and remove the unnecessary comments that plague every online recipe. You can add ingredients manually to the shopping list or dump from the meal plan. Perfect app for busy people who cook at home!

title: Best kitchen tool yet
body: This is an amazing app! Easy to use and so clever! Its my new best cooking companion!

title: Recommend over physical book
body: I recommend this app over having a ton of physical books where you only use a few recipes. My go to over books when meal planning. I use the free version for now. I intend to pay the small amount for family sharing in near future. I love that you can edit saved recipes where I had tips or remove items/substitute within ingredients. I love the search option & delete option when I saved same recipe more than once. I love I can add my own recipes. Easy to use. Not sure if it’s an option but someday I’d love to have my treasures made into my own favorite recipe book! Thank you for such a great app with no issues!

title: The only recipe collection app I use!
body: Love how easy it is to save from the web. Easy to reference, fun to use!

title: Best app ever
body: I love this app so much. I love cooking and finding recipes online but it was so frustrating trying to find the list of ingredients and instructions. This app gives you all the information you need. It has been a life safer for me. Thank you.

title: Love it!
body: Everyone needs this!

title: Great and easy app to use
body: This app is great for saving your favorite recipes and having them on hand. Love the Lock Screen feature and ability to increase and decrease portion size. Helpful also for counting macros!

title: Just the app I was looking for
body: I’ve been using Stashcook for about a month now, and I’ve been extremely happy with it. The import function works well with minor exceptions and I love the meal planner and ability to send ingredients directly to the shopping list. The one feature I feel like this is missing is the ability to make footnotes on recipes. There are times when I modify a recipe and want to note what I did without altering the base recipe or make other notes about usage, but there is not a great way to do this.

title: Amazing Meal Planning App
body: Everything in one place. Easy to make shopping lists. Only recipe and planning app I use.

title: Love it
body: Makes life easier and more organized 👏

title: Great app to save recipes!
body: When I come across a recipe on the internet that sounds good but don’t want to make it now, I save the recipe to Stashcook so I have it at my fingertips later. Great app!! Love it!!

title: Game. Changer. !!
body: My sister recommended this and it’s my all time favorite app! I used to find a recipe on the internet, make it, and never be able to find it again. This makes it so easy to save and import recipes. Love it and recommend it to everyone

title: Greatest cooking organization app
body: I love this app! My husband and I love using it to meal plan, save recipes, and share a shopping list. That last one is important as I no longer have to keep making list and him still forgetting things at the store.

title: Love this recipe keeper!
body: I love the convenience of saving all my recipes in one place. I love that I can categorize them which makes it so easy to find the recipe I need.

title: Best app EVER!
body: This app has helped me in so many ways. Meal planning is simple, my shopping list is simple and loading recipes in the app is simple. I have shared with this app with all my friends. Game changer!

title: Excellent app
body: Totally worth the money, it makes it so easy to save the recipes I find and truly want to make, make lists, and helps me follow the recipe better.

title: Brilliant Recipe Management
body: Finally! Other recipe apps are overly complex at the expense of core functionality. (I don’t need another social media app! I need a “smart” recipe library that handles data elegantly and enables me to collaborate on meal planning with my partner.) Enter Stashcook. Stashcook ticks all the boxes, and is intuitive and pleasant to use. The app imports recipes flawlessly. It creates shopping lists flawlessly. The developers are also thoughtful and responsive to user input, which is a big bonus. Highly recommend. 11 million stars.

title: Great Meal Planning App
body: Highly recommend this app as it’s easy to visualize and catalog recipes. Gone are the days of reading a web page for recipes and trying to remember what you googled to find something!

title: Best app EVER
body: I am in love with Stashcook! I was complaining to a friend that I had lost motivation to cook recently and never seem to remember my husband’s favorite dishes when he says “I love this one. Please make this again” and I think okay, sure thing. Then time goes by and I’m flipping though cookbooks or searching online and nothing sounds very inspiring and I can’t recall which ones he loved. It seems like it would be easy to remember things like that but with two toddlers, I need a little help. She told me about Stashcook and wow what a game changer this app is! It has given me a whole new motivation for cooking and I am forever thankful. The grocery list feature is fantastic and I’ve been telling all my girlfriends about it! Thank you!!

title: Yesssss!
body: Love, love this app! So easy to pull in recipes from all over the web and seamlessly add to a meal plan and grocery list. Love that I can “stash” my recipes in many ways or create my own. This app is what I’ve been looking for and far exceeds my expectations. Would be great to be able to sort the recipes by multiple collections (like by protein type “chicken” and season “summer”, for example, especially as I continue to use and build out collections). But truly such a great app, thank you!!!

title: Still a great app, minor feature/fix requests
body: I do love this app! A couple things keep shifting - it seems like there’s been only one release where the “send to Stashcook” and “stash from a copied URL” feature both worked (although Send often crashed, so I’m happy to have the Copied URL stash feature back). And, the latest release doesn’t remember your prior sort from the Home Screen - which I’m sad about because it was my way of coping with crashes from the Send feature. I have one main feature wish, though, that I hope is on the back burner: the ability to print or PDF recipes, especially (but not only) personal recipes. I put a bunch in here only then threw out the paper, and I’m having some regrets on that. It’s much nicer to know a family recipe is safe in print if something ever happens to me, you know?

title: The perfect meal planner for a busy mum!
body: For someone who uses recipes regularly, shares recipes with friends and family and (before stash cook) would forever forget where the best recipes are hidden somewhere within the millions of recipes you can find on the internet...this is the perfect app! I will never ‘lose’ a decent recipe again! And as a busy working Mum I find my life runs just a little bit smoother when I’ve planned all dinners for the week ahead, so the meal planner/shopping list feature is brilliant! Thank you Stash cook!
